parsed.name: QuTech QWG任意波形发生器模块
parsed.name_en: QuTech QWG Arbitrary Waveform Generator Module
parsed.description: QuTech QWG 是一款面向量子实验的任意波形发生器模块，可输出多通道控制波形、管理波形与序列、支持基于 DIO 的 codeword 触发与校准，常用于量子比特控制和读出实验。
parsed.description_en: The QuTech QWG is an arbitrary waveform generator module for quantum experiments. It outputs multi-channel control waveforms, manages waveform and sequence memory, supports DIO codeword triggering and calibration, and is commonly used for qubit control and readout setups.
